channel.title: Robotics Directory - Smart Home Robots
channel.description: Browse 96 smart home robots in the Robotics Directory. Specs, prices, images and comparison.

item.title: Amazon Ring Drone Cam
item.description: Ring Drone Cam is Ring's flying indoor security camera, announced on 10 November 2026. Its AI Pilot system maps the home, suggests patrol points and flies autonomously around obstacles. It records 2K video with a 148° field of view, can rotate 360° and has built-in LED lights for low-light recording. Between flights it powers down in its dock with the camera off and records only once a flight is triggered. Scheduled flights require a compatible Ring Protect plan. US availability is 27 January 2027 at 249.99 USD. Amazon publishes no flight time, mass, dimensions or charging time.

item.title: SwitchBot Onero H1
item.description: Wheeled humanoid housebot with 22 DoF for laundry and chores.

item.title: Rollo Robotics Rollo
item.description: Estonian autonomous security robot patrolling routes with 360-degree surveillance.

item.title: Sagtec HALO AI Food-Serving Robot
item.description: Restaurant food-serving robot commercially launched August 18, 2026, alongside a distributor order for Dubai. Retail unit pricing was not disclosed.

item.title: Tuesday Labs Voxel Series-1
item.description: Counter-height 'droid butler' home robot from a NYC startup founded by a former Boston Dynamics roboticist, with a character design by an ex-Pixar designer. It handles tidying tasks such as watering plants and sweeping crumbs through a mix of autonomy and teleoperation. Reservations cost 200 USD.

item.title: Enabot EBO Max
item.description: Football-shaped wheeled family robot with a 4K camera and an embodied AI brain with long-term memory and natural-language interaction. It handles home and pet monitoring, fall-detection alerts, two-way video and multi-step scheduled tasks. Pre-orders opened in March 2026.

item.title: Enabot EBO Mini
item.description: Compact wheeled home and pet robot with a 2K camera, night vision and two-way audio. It avoids obstacles, docks itself to charge and offers laser play for pets.

item.title: Enabot EBO Mini Sport
item.description: Upgraded EBO Mini with a quieter brushless motor, dynamic eye lighting and AI recognition of people and pets. Like the EBO Mini it has a 2K camera, night vision, two-way audio, obstacle avoidance and self-docking.

item.title: Haier HIVA Household Robot
item.description: In-house household-chores robot in Haier's HIVA ('Haiwa') family, launched at AWE 2026 in March 2026 after Haier announced the HIVA home-robot project in July 2025. Linked to Haier's smart-home brain, it spots clothes to be washed, has the washing machine open its door and loads the laundry with soft grasping, manages fridge food by reading expiry dates and opening and closing the fridge door, and handles fine tasks such as peeling a banana.

item.title: Enabot EBO SE 2
item.description: EBO SE 2 is a movable pet and home monitoring robot from Enabot with a 2K camera, whole-home mobility and two-way audio.

item.title: Hello Robot Stretch 4
item.description: Stretch 4 is the fourth-generation mobile manipulator from Hello Robot, unveiled in May 2026 for homes, assistive use and research. It has a telescoping arm with 55 cm reach plus a 6 cm wrist, 4 kg payload with the arm retracted (2.5 kg extended), an omnidirectional base, self-charging, up to 8 hours runtime and an open-source ROS 2 and Python SDK.

item.title: Piaggio Fast Forward Grogu Gitamini
item.description: The Grogu gita mini is a Star Wars-licensed version of Piaggio Fast Forward's gitamini cargo-following robot, styled after Grogu's hover-pram from The Mandalorian and released in 2026. It follows its owner by camera at the tap of a button, indoors and outdoors over varied terrain, and carries up to 20 lb of gear; it sells for 2,875 USD.

item.title: Zeroth N1
item.description: Home collaborative robot from Zeroth (元点机器人) shown in August 2026 with a heterogeneous dual-arm design that can split into two robots that share information and work separately. It occupies about 0.2 m², turns on the spot and lifts its shoulder pivot between 63 and 128 cm to reach counters and kitchen worktops.

item.title: Syncere Lume
item.description: Home robot from Palo Alto startup Syncere that folds into a floor lamp and, when activated, unfolds an articulated arm and drives itself to fold laundry, make the bed, reset pillows and tidy rooms using onboard perception and local AI compute. Sold from 2,699 USD with a charging dock and a Personalization Band used to demonstrate chores; named one of TIME's Best Inventions of 2026.

item.title: Nori Robotics A3
item.description: The A3 is a wheeled, two-armed home robot from Y Combinator-backed startup Nori Robotics, built in San Francisco and priced at $1,688. Rather than shipping with fixed skills, it is meant to be trained by owners via a desktop simulator or code to handle tasks such as cooking, fetching items, loading a dishwasher and folding laundry, and it navigates with LiDAR and cameras on up to 8 hours of battery.

item.title: Flourish Robots 1
item.description: Flourish 1 is a 3,555 USD wheeled home robot from San Francisco startup Flourish Robots, designed to take on repetitive household chores such as picking up shoes, clothes and toys, loading the dishwasher, wiping tables, watering plants, fetching items and clearing a litter box. Owners teach it a new task in about 30 minutes through a no-code mobile app by physically demonstrating the motion; pre-orders for the first 50 units opened in September 2026 with deliveries beginning December 2026.

item.title: Haier CR3
item.description: The CR3 (marketed as Chef Genius CR3 / 厨天才CR3) is an AI-powered home cooking robot from Haier, co-developed with Chinese startup Xianglu Robotics, that automatically prepares dishes in the kitchen. It launched for pre-sale on 24 September 2026 alongside Haier's flagship store opening in Wuhan, as part of Haier's smart-home lineup addressing everyday household chores.

item.title: wan AIChef ultra
item.description: wan AIChef ultra is a countertop home cooking robot built around an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano processor, a 12MP AI vision camera for ingredient recognition, and infrared thermal imaging for precision heat control, positioned as an all-in-one replacement for a microwave, steamer, oven, slow cooker and skillet with a library of 1,000+ recipes. Made by Shenzhen wan AIChef Technology, it launched on Indiegogo on September 1, 2026 at an MSRP of $3,999, shipping to the US, Canada, Germany, France, Australia and Austria from November 2026.

item.title: Enabot EBO Air 2
item.description: Mobile 2K pet/home camera robot; 137° FOV, night vision, two-way talk, auto-recharge, custom expressions

item.title: Posha Posha
item.description: Countertop cooking robot; computer-vision guided, auto ingredient/spice dispensing, induction cooktop

item.title: SwitchBot K20+ Pro Patrol Kit
item.description: Mini robot vacuum and mobile patrol base carrying an indoor security camera.

item.title: Enabot EBO Air 2S
item.description: EBO Air 2S is an Enabot FamilyBot home robot that offers 24/7 monitoring with a custom patrol mode, two-way video calls and real-time remote viewing for home security, pet care and family connection.

item.title: Enabot EBO Air 2 Plus
item.description: EBO Air 2 Plus is Enabot's 'FamilyBot' mobile home robot camera with 3K video, a 5 MP camera with a 137° lens and infrared night vision, autonomous patrols, person and pet tracking, and video calls displayed on its animated eye screens. It includes ChatGPT-based conversational AI, a 5,000 mAh battery with automatic return to its dock, and a 32 GB microSD card for local storage.

item.title: Essen Rein
item.description: Rein is a multi-function kitchen robot made by Argentine cookware brand Essen, launched in August 2025 as the company's first entry into electric kitchen appliances. It has a 3-liter bowl, a touchscreen interface with guided recipes, and combines cooking functions the maker says replace more than 20 separate kitchen appliances.

item.title: Vorwerk Thermomix TM7
item.description: The Thermomix TM7 is Vorwerk's latest all-in-one cooking robot, successor to the TM6, combining stirring, mixing, cooking and steaming functions with a large touchscreen and a guided, step-by-step cooking mode linked to the Cookidoo recipe platform. It offers more than 30 cooking modes.

item.title: LG Q9 AI Agent
item.description: Two-wheeled self-driving smart home hub; voice AI, appliance control, temp/humidity/air sensors, pet watch

item.title: Chef Robotics Chef
item.description: AI food-assembly robot arm for commercial kitchens; flexible ingredient picking, NSF-certified, RaaS model

item.title: Baidu Xiaodu Tiantian Family Robot
item.description: ERNIE LLM family robot, detachable tablet head + speaker body, face-following, home appliance control

item.title: NUWA Robotics Collibot
item.description: Taiwanese modular autonomous serving robot for restaurants with leveling-suspension trays.

item.title: TechMagic I-Robo2
item.description: Stir-fry robot cooking over 350C, replicating chefs across 200+ recipes.

item.title: Botinkit Omni
item.description: AI wok cooking robot that stir-fries, seasons and self-cleans with 10000+ recipes across 30+ cuisines; 30L wok, 350°C max temp, induction heating, 1 m² footprint, auto seasoning and auto clean.

item.title: Suvie Suvie 3.0 Plus
item.description: A multi-zone countertop cooking robot featuring Cool-to-Cook technology that keeps meals refrigerated until scheduling automatically triggers air fry, sous vide, or roast.

item.title: Segway DeliverBot D2
item.description: Indoor delivery robot for hotels, hospitals and offices with VILO-SLAM 2.0 navigation, Bluetooth elevator integration for multi-floor delivery, 32L cargo capacity and 7-inch touchscreen.

item.title: Hello Robot Stretch 3
item.description: Lightweight open-source mobile manipulator with a telescoping arm, lift and DexWrist 3 gripper with an integrated camera. Built for home-assistance and embodied-AI research and programmable with ROS 2 and Python.

item.title: Enabot ROLA PetPal
item.description: Autonomous pet-sitting robot with an HD camera that moves through the house. It offers two-way voice, interactive toys and automatic treat dispensing, and recharges itself. An optional Cloud+ subscription adds playback and smart alerts.

item.title: Enabot ROLA Mini
item.description: ROLA Mini is a compact tracked pet-monitoring robot from Enabot with a 3 MP 2K QHD camera (2304 x 1296, 137° field of view), night vision and pet-play functions. It uses a planetary gearbox track drive with active noise reduction, moves at 20-60 cm/s, crosses 10 mm obstacles and has a built-in 5,000 mAh battery.

item.title: Amazon Astro for Business
item.description: Ring integration, autonomous patrol, object detection

item.title: Aeolus Robotics Aeo
item.description: Dual-arm manipulation, disinfection, delivery

item.title: Enabot EBO X
item.description: Self-balancing family robot; 4K stabilized gimbal camera, V-SLAM mapping, Alexa, fall/cry alerts, Harman audio

item.title: Matic Robots Matic
item.description: Vacuum-mop with 5-camera visual SLAM, on-device AI, 55 dB quiet; 2.5h vacuum or 3h mop per charge

item.title: Aniai Alpha Grill
item.description: Robotic dual-sided clamshell grill cooking over 200 burgers per hour.

item.title: XRobotics xPizza Cube
item.description: Compact countertop robot topping up to 100 pizzas per hour.

item.title: Yunji Technology UP
item.description: Modular hotel robot combining item delivery and carpet cleaning.

item.title: Labrador Systems Labrador Retriever
item.description: Autonomous tray delivery, height adjustable

item.title: GE Profile Smart Mixer
item.description: Auto-sensing, voice control, smart weighing

item.title: Cecilia.ai Cecilia
item.description: Interactive AI robotic bartender mixing 120 cocktails per hour.

item.title: Pudu Robotics PUDU D1
item.description: First commercial delivery-quadruped robot; 16-core CPU, 30Tops AI computing, 19-bit encoders, CAN-FD comms, auto-leveling delivery box, proprietary joint modules for varied terrain.

item.title: Pudu Robotics SwiftBot
item.description: Wheeled restaurant delivery robot with automatic electric door and LiDAR.

item.title: Reeman PANDA Delivery Robot
item.description: Multi-scenario item delivery robot for offices, hotels and hospitals.

item.title: LG CLOi ServeBot LDLIM21
item.description: Three-shelf autonomous serving robot using LiDAR and 3D cameras to navigate restaurant, hotel, and office halls, delivering up to 30 kg of cargo with 11-hour runtime.
